summary: Recognize explicit RFI and Submittal email Subjects behind a bounded sequence of reply, forward and bracketed enterprise security labels.
decision_refs: Active user goal to continue improving accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and email content
Confirmed synthetic reproductions where [EXTERNAL] and [External Email] labels hid otherwise explicit workflow Subjects
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly includes continued RFI, Submittal and email adaptability improvements.
known_limitations: At most six supported prefix tokens are skipped and each bracketed label is limited to 40 characters.
Unbracketed vendor-specific security prose and semantic Subject inference remain unsupported.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no mailbox, model or external provider request is used.
